name: VIP Sunday
description:
VIP Sunday – A Day to Honor Someone Special! 
On Sunday Nov. 2 we’re celebrating the people who’ve made a difference in our lives!
This is the perfect Sunday to bring someone who doesn’t usually come to church — and show them what it looks like to be known, welcomed, and loved.

Invite your “Very Important Person” — a friend, neighbor, coworker, or family member — for a morning designed to make them feel loved and valued by you.


We’ll have a red carpet welcome, special gifts for our VIP guests, and a uplifting, relatable message that speaks to real life.
After the message, let's celebrate your VIP with a curated board, chocolate fountain and a toast to celebrate!
Let’s fill the house with friendship and faith!
Bring your VIP and join us for this unforgettable day at Thrive Vineyard Church.
8:30 or 9:30 am
VIP check-in 15 minutes before both services.

name: Thrive Revive in ’25
description:
Thrive Revive in ’25 — Let’s Build for the Next Generation (and Enjoy More Coffee Together ☕)


Thrive family, we’ve got exciting news to share! Someone in our church has generously given a $10,000 matching grant to help us revitalize two important areas of our church life: our Children’s Ministry area and our Café space.


Here’s why this matters:• Our Children’s Ministry currently lacks walls, making it noisy and distracting. We want to create a beautiful, fresh, quiet environment where kids can encounter God’s love.• Our Café has become one of Thrive’s best connection points but is running out of room! We’ll expand seating and update the look to reflect Thrive’s warm, welcoming culture.


Every dollar you give will be doubled up to $10,000 — meaning we can raise $20,000 total!


This isn’t just about paint and walls—it’s about building spaces where kids grow in faith and friendships flourish.


Give via: Zelle address: give@thrivevineyard.com — include “Thrive Revive” in the memo, or give by check.


With gratitude and excitement,Kevin

Our church family has gathered a wide variety of gently used clothing, home goods, and other items that are ready for a new home. Whether you need something for your wardrobe, your kitchen, or just want to browse, we invite you to come and take what you need.
